g.title: J8
g.text: Zero 2 W. Pin 1 is nearest the microSD slot, inner row (square pad on the underside). Pin 1 also feeds U2; see wiring-audio.

g.title: U5
g.text: Custom board in boards.md. Up to four Kailh BOX switches in hot-swap sockets, 10k pull-ups, 1k series, RC and TVS per channel, SMD backlight LEDs with one PWM MOSFET. J51 shown; J52 LED supply is in wiring-power.

g.title: U3
g.text: Retained module; E4 open. VCC 3.3 V. IN LOW energizes the coil; GPIO5 and GPIO6 are driven high from boot. Coil supply and contacts are in wiring-power.

g.title: U6
g.text: Adafruit 4885, I2C address 0x44, beside the camera window. 3V pad is the breakout regulator output and stays unconnected.

g.title: U7
g.text: Heater control input J76 to the Q71 gate network. HEATER high turns HTR1 on. Power terminals are in wiring-power.
